name: setup
description: Set up a port, baud rate / 10, config 0 is 8N1 (port,baud,config)->()

name: available
description: Number of received bytes waiting to be read (port)->(count)

name: read
description: Read one received byte, -1 if there is none (port)->(byte)

name: write_available
description: Number of bytes that can be sent without waiting, 0 while busy (port)->(count)

name: read_str
description: Read up to max received bytes into a string (port,dest_index,max)->(count)

name: read_mem
description: Read up to max received bytes into memory, one per cell (port,address,max)->(count)

name: write_str
description: Send length bytes of a string from start (port,src_index,start,length)->(count)

name: write_mem
description: Send length bytes from memory, one per cell (port,address,length)->(count)
